name: Laguna Wilcacocha
why: The first acclimatization walk from Huaraz: up through farm hamlets of the Cordillera Negra to a small lake that faces the whole snowy Cordillera Blanca.
book: Free, no permit. Colectivo E or 10 from the Mercado Central in Huaraz (15 minutes, about S/1.5): ask for Chiwipampa, Puente Santa Cruz. Blue arrows mark the path from the bridge.
water: Nothing to buy after the road: carry 1.5 litres.
dangers: Altitude: you climb from about 3,200 to 3,725 m, so walk slowly if you arrived from the coast in the last two days.
Strong sun and no shade on the open slopes.
Farm dogs in the hamlets: keep walking calmly, a stick helps.
turnaround: Headache, nausea or shortness of breath at rest: go back down, that is the point of an acclimatization walk.

points.name: Chiwipampa, Puente Santa Cruz
points.note: The bridge over the Río Santa where the colectivo stops. Cross it and follow the blue arrows up between the houses and fields.

points.name: Laguna Wilcacocha
points.note: About 3,725 m. A small reedy lake; the reason to come is the view east over Huaraz to Huascarán and the Cordillera Blanca. Return the same way.
